paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academics in the region [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary has been recognized at the highest levels of academic excellence in China, as the program specifically targets scholars who have made significant contributions to their fields [Exhibit A1, p.2]. The 'Hundred People Project' represents a highly competitive selection process that identifies only the most distinguished scholars, placing the Beneficiary among an elite group of academic leaders in Beijing [Exhibit A1, p.2]. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, a nationally recognized award established by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in 2009 [Exhibit A1, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.4]. This award is administered through a rigorous evaluation process conducted every three years by an Award Committee composed of the director and deputy directors of the Social Sciences Committee of the Ministry of Education, along with heads of relevant departments and bureaus [Exhibit B10, p.4; Exhibit B10, p.5]. The evaluation committee selects experts and scholars with high academic attainments from across the country to review submissions according to strict criteria requiring theoretical achievements, academic innovation, and significant contributions to discipline development [Exhibit B10, p.5]. All awards are divided into grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes, with the Beneficiary's third prize representing recognition at the national level among thousands of submissions from higher education institutions across China [Exhibit B10, p.5]. In addition to the above, the Beneficiary received the Data Legacy of the Year Award at the 2019 Data Awards, which are pronounced the same as 'beacon' in Chinese and represent one of the most influential awards in the field of mobile Internet [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.2]. These awards were jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association, and China Big Data Industry Observation to recognize benchmarking enterprises and experts with outstanding contributions and influence in the big data industry [Exhibit B3, p.3]. The selection process involved a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University, and Peking University, who reviewed candidates during a two-month evaluation period [Exhibit B3, p.3]. Through the development of professional selection models, only 28 Data individuals stood out from what was undoubtedly a large pool of candidates across seven categories of Data Awards, making the Beneficiary's recognition particularly selective and prestigious [Exhibit B3, p.4]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award specifically recognizes individuals who have worked deeply in big data and mobile Internet for many years, spreading insights and experiences while educating the entire industry and leading Internet practitioners to continuously inherit data application, industry methodology, and scientific research [Exhibit B3, p.7]. Moreover, the Beneficiary's paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time' won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award was conferred by the Communication Association of China through the 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee, representing recognition at a major national communication conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The Excellent Paper Award demonstrates that the Beneficiary's research has been evaluated and recognized by peers in the field of communication studies as making a significant contribution to the discipline [Exhibit B11, p.2]. Additionally, the Beneficiary's recognition extends to multiple industry sectors, as evidenced by Umen+'s receipt of numerous prestigious awards including Enterprise Service High-growth Company from 36 Kr and China Big Data Industry Application TOP Choice in Three Major Fields [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These awards demonstrate that organizations with which the Beneficiary is associated have been recognized at the highest levels of the data industry, further validating the Beneficiary's standing within these prestigious enterprises and industry groups [Exhibit B4, p.4]. The cumulative effect of these multiple recognitions across different industry contexts underscores the Beneficiary's sustained excellence and influence in both academic and professional spheres [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
